title: AI Scientist Safety Issues: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis

contributions.purpose: 提出 AI 科学家安全的四类风险分类法
contributions.mechanism: 把风险归为 Technical Safety / Research Integrity / Dual-Use / Alignment 四类并作互联分析(Figure 1 taxonomy)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:综述性框架,无实证
contributions.source_quote: we identify four critical risk categories: technical failures and hallucinations, dual-use and misuse potential, research integrity violations, and autonomous system alignment problems.

contributions.purpose: 汇总已记录的失败模式与失败率
contributions.mechanism: 综述文献/案例(Sakana AI Scientist、GPT-4 fabrication 等),制表列出幻觉率与失败率
contributions.evaluation: 幻觉率 1.7%(GPT-4 Turbo)–33%(o3);实验编码失败率 42%;Table2 声称 fabrication 12%、量化推理错误 35% 等
contributions.source_quote: they exhibit concerning failure modes including systematic hallucination rates (1.7-33%), research fabrication, and dangerous autonomous behaviors.

contributions.purpose: 给出安全评估与治理建议
contributions.mechanism: 提出技术保障(容器化/行为监控/多系统共识)+治理认证/国际协调框架
contributions.source_quote: We propose a framework for evaluating AI scientist safety and provide recommendations for safer deployment of automated research systems.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This survey provides the first comprehensive analysis of safety issues specific to AI-driven scientific research systems.
